title: Runic Assets archive manifest (runic-assets.json)
description: The shape of the manifest of runic.assets.archive/1 and /2, with closed enumerations. The reader rules in archive-v1.md add what a schema cannot say: the JSON profile (UTF-8, no duplicate member names), integer lengths without a fraction or exponent, the path rules, unique paths, one entry point, contentPath's target and the ZIP entries. Members this schema does not define are ignored by readers.

path.description: A string; the path rules of archive-v1.md decide which strings are safe.
